natural_language: How many buses are represented in this SimBench network?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bus_count FROM buses

natural_language: How many lines are in the network?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lines

natural_language: How many transformers are available?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transformer_count FROM transformers

natural_language: How many load assets are recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS load_count FROM loads

natural_language: How many distributed generators are recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS generator_count FROM generators

natural_language: How many switches are represented?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS switch_count FROM switches

natural_language: List buses whose nominal voltage is at least 100 kV.
gold_sql: SELECT bus_id, name, nominal_kv FROM buses WHERE nominal_kv >= 100 ORDER BY bus_id

natural_language: List in-service lines longer than 2 km.
gold_sql: SELECT line_id, name, length_km FROM lines WHERE in_service = 1 AND length_km > 2 ORDER BY length_km DESC, line_id

natural_language: Which loads have a maximum active power above 1 MW?
gold_sql: SELECT load_id, name, maximum_active_power_mw FROM loads WHERE maximum_active_power_mw > 1 ORDER BY maximum_active_power_mw DESC, load_id

natural_language: Which generators are controllable?
gold_sql: SELECT generator_id, name, generator_type FROM generators WHERE controllable = 1 ORDER BY generator_id

natural_language: List all normally open switches.
gold_sql: SELECT switch_id, name, element_type FROM switches WHERE closed = 0 ORDER BY switch_id

natural_language: List hydro generators in service.
gold_sql: SELECT generator_id, name, active_power_mw FROM generators WHERE generator_type LIKE '%Hydro%' AND in_service = 1 ORDER BY generator_id

natural_language: What is the total maximum active power of all loads in MW?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(maximum_active_power_mw), 6) AS total_load_max_mw FROM loads

natural_language: What is the total maximum active power of all distributed generators in MW?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(maximum_active_power_mw), 6) AS total_generation_max_mw FROM generators

natural_language: What is the average line length in kilometres?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(length_km), 6) AS average_line_length_km FROM lines

natural_language: What is the total rated transformer capacity in MVA?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(rated_power_mva), 6) AS total_transformer_mva FROM transformers

natural_language: How many buses belong to each nominal voltage level?
gold_sql: SELECT nominal_kv, COUNT(*) AS bus_count FROM buses GROUP BY nominal_kv ORDER BY nominal_kv DESC

natural_language: How many open and closed switches are there?
gold_sql: SELECT closed, COUNT(*) AS switch_count FROM switches GROUP BY closed ORDER BY closed

natural_language: Show the five loads with the largest maximum active power and their bus names.
gold_sql: SELECT l.load_id, l.name AS load_name, b.name AS bus_name, l.maximum_active_power_mw FROM loads l JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = l.bus_id ORDER BY l.maximum_active_power_mw DESC, l.load_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Show each hydro generator together with its connected bus and nominal voltage.
gold_sql: SELECT g.name AS generator_name, b.name AS bus_name, b.nominal_kv FROM generators g JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = g.bus_id WHERE g.generator_type LIKE '%Hydro%' ORDER BY g.generator_id

natural_language: Show transformer names with their high- and low-voltage bus names.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS transformer_name, hb.name AS high_voltage_bus, lb.name AS low_voltage_bus FROM transformers t JOIN buses hb ON hb.bus_id = t.hv_bus_id JOIN buses lb ON lb.bus_id = t.lv_bus_id ORDER BY t.transformer_id

natural_language: Show the first five lines with their from-bus and to-bus names.
gold_sql: SELECT l.line_id, l.name AS line_name, fb.name AS from_bus, tb.name AS to_bus FROM lines l JOIN buses fb ON fb.bus_id = l.from_bus_id JOIN buses tb ON tb.bus_id = l.to_bus_id ORDER BY l.line_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Count loads by the nominal voltage of their connected bus.
gold_sql: SELECT b.nominal_kv, COUNT(*) AS load_count FROM loads l JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = l.bus_id GROUP BY b.nominal_kv ORDER BY b.nominal_kv DESC

natural_language: Count generators at each connected bus and show only buses with more than one generator.
gold_sql: SELECT b.bus_id, b.name, COUNT(*) AS generator_count FROM generators g JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = g.bus_id GROUP BY b.bus_id, b.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY generator_count DESC, b.bus_id

natural_language: Which five loads have the highest maximum active power?
gold_sql: SELECT load_id, name, maximum_active_power_mw FROM loads ORDER BY maximum_active_power_mw DESC, load_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which five generators have the highest maximum active power?
gold_sql: SELECT generator_id, name, maximum_active_power_mw FROM generators ORDER BY maximum_active_power_mw DESC, generator_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which five lines are the longest?
gold_sql: SELECT line_id, name, length_km FROM lines ORDER BY length_km DESC, line_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which transformer has the largest rated power?
gold_sql: SELECT transformer_id, name, rated_power_mva FROM transformers ORDER BY rated_power_mva DESC, transformer_id LIMIT 1

natural_language: Which five load profiles occur most often?
gold_sql: SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS load_count FROM loads GROUP BY profile ORDER BY load_count DESC, profile LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which five generator profiles occur most often?
gold_sql: SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS generator_count FROM generators GROUP BY profile ORDER BY generator_count DESC, profile LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which five buses have the highest line degree?
gold_sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT from_bus_id AS bus_id FROM lines UNION ALL SELECT to_bus_id AS bus_id FROM lines) SELECT b.bus_id, b.name, COUNT(*) AS line_degree FROM endpoints e JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = e.bus_id GROUP BY b.bus_id, b.name ORDER BY line_degree DESC, b.bus_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: How many in-service line connections touch each of the five highest-degree buses?
gold_sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT from_bus_id AS bus_id FROM lines WHERE in_service = 1 UNION ALL SELECT to_bus_id AS bus_id FROM lines WHERE in_service = 1) SELECT b.bus_id, b.name, COUNT(*) AS in_service_degree FROM endpoints e JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = e.bus_id GROUP BY b.bus_id, b.name ORDER BY in_service_degree DESC, b.bus_id LIMIT 5

natural_language: Which buses have no incident line?
gold_sql: SELECT b.bus_id, b.name FROM buses b LEFT JOIN lines l1 ON l1.from_bus_id = b.bus_id LEFT JOIN lines l2 ON l2.to_bus_id = b.bus_id WHERE l1.line_id IS NULL AND l2.line_id IS NULL ORDER BY b.bus_id

natural_language: Show open switches that are attached to line elements, including the line name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.switch_id, s.name AS switch_name, l.line_id, l.name AS line_name FROM switches s JOIN lines l ON s.element_type = 'l' AND l.line_id = s.element_id WHERE s.closed = 0 ORDER BY s.switch_id

natural_language: Which lines connect buses with different nominal voltages?
gold_sql: SELECT l.line_id, l.name, fb.nominal_kv AS from_kv, tb.nominal_kv AS to_kv FROM lines l JOIN buses fb ON fb.bus_id = l.from_bus_id JOIN buses tb ON tb.bus_id = l.to_bus_id WHERE fb.nominal_kv <> tb.nominal_kv ORDER BY l.line_id

natural_language: For each transformer, show the nominal voltage transition between its connected buses.
gold_sql: SELECT t.transformer_id, t.name, hb.nominal_kv AS high_bus_kv, lb.nominal_kv AS low_bus_kv FROM transformers t JOIN buses hb ON hb.bus_id = t.hv_bus_id JOIN buses lb ON lb.bus_id = t.lv_bus_id ORDER BY t.transformer_id
